title: Samson Messes Up
textBlocks:
Hello Bravehearts
In today’s true Bible story, 
you will hear how Samson makes a big mistake

Before Smason was even born, The Angel of the Lord told Manoah’s wife that she would have a boy child.
AND THEY WEREN’T ALLOWED TO CUT THE CHILD’S HAIR

THAT WAS THE SECRET TO HIS STRENGTH - HIS UNCUT HAIR

Samson didn’t follow these rules
and in the in lost his strength and was blinded and was captured.

BUT GOD STILL USED HIM EVEN THOUGH HE MADE BIG BIG MISTAKES
Samson cried out to the Lord, and his strenght returned and he destroyed the Philistines
Watch how his hair gets cut

YOU WILL NEED
Wool 
Scissors
Ice cream stick
Prestick or glue
and something to make strong arms
